environment_interactions: Installing the opt-in integration-conformance dev group pulls anthropic>=1.0 and therefore httpx2; Starlette 1.3's TestClient then binds to httpx2 and returns httpx2.Response objects, so four pre-existing SDK tests that forward through TestClient inside an httpx.MockTransport fail (tests/sdk/test_calculation_inputs.py and tests/sdk/test_charge_cost_revision_access.py, sqlite and postgres variants). They pass with the default groups (which is what CI installs). Fixes: accept either httpx or httpx2 responses in those handlers, or pin anthropic<1 in the group (which would change the C01 harness version and require re-verifying C01).
